title: Definition and Scope of 'Schedule' (Tofshil)
summary: The definition of 'Schedule' (তফসিল) remains legally static across various rules, consistently defined as any schedule attached to the respective rules. While the definition itself does not evolve in substance, it serves as a foundational legal anchor for baggage declarations and warehouse inventory procedures.

evolution.legal_basis: Remains consistent as a reference to appended schedules within the specific rule set.

timeline.change: Reiteration of definition in updated 2024 context.

Baggage: Baggage is defined as a reasonable quantity of food items, apparel, household goods, or other personal effects imported by a passenger.
Passenger: A passenger is defined as any person arriving from abroad.

২। সংজ্ঞা।— বিষয় বা প্রসঙ্গের পরিপন্থী কোনো কিছু না থাকিলে, এই বিধিমালায় -
(১) ‘‘তফসিল’’ অর্থ এই বিধিমালার কোনো তফসিল;
(২) ‘‘ব্যাগেজ’’ অর্থ কোনো যাত্রী কর্তৃক আমদানিকৃত যুক্তিসঙ্গত পরিমাণের খাদ্যদ্রব্য, পরিধেয়, গৃহস্থালী বা অন্যবিধ ব্যক্তিগত সামগ্রী, যার প্রতিটি আইটেমের ওজন ১৫ কেজির অধিক নহে; এবং
(৩) ‘‘যাত্রী’’ অর্থ বিদেশ হইতে আগত কোনো যাত্রী।

Schedule: The term is defined as any schedule specifically contained within these rules.
Baggage: Baggage refers to food items, clothing, household goods, or other personal effects imported by a passenger in reasonable quantities. Each individual item of baggage must not exceed a specified weight threshold.
Passenger: A passenger is defined as any individual arriving from abroad.

Customs Act 2023: This law is formally defined as the Customs Act 2023.
Commissariat: A commissariat is an authorized establishment that sells food, cigarettes, liquor, and other beverages to foreign investors, workers, and technicians within export processing zones.
Duty Paid Bonded Warehouse: This refers to an establishment that sells bonded imported goods to foreign citizens residing or present in Bangladesh, subject to the payment of applicable duties and taxes in foreign currency.
Duty Free Bonded Warehouse: This refers to an establishment that sells bonded imported goods duty-free to arriving or departing passengers in exchange for foreign currency.
Diplomatic Bonded Warehouse: This refers to an establishment that sells bonded imported goods duty-free to diplomats or foreign citizens enjoying special privileges in exchange for foreign currency.
Schedule: This term refers to any schedule contained within these rules.
Deemed Export-Oriented Industrial Unit: This refers to an industrial unit that produces and supplies auxiliary materials to fully export-oriented industries through back-to-back letters of credit as a backward linkage industry.
Form: This term refers to any form prescribed within these rules.
Combined Deemed and Direct Export-Orient: This refers to an industrial unit that exports a portion of its products directly abroad and supplies the remaining portion as backward linkage to direct exporters via back-to-back letters of credit.
Warehouse License: This license is granted under Section 12 of the Customs Act 2023.
Licensee: This refers to any person, institution, or company that has been granted a license under these rules.
Licensing Authority: This refers to the licensing authority designated under Rule 3 of these rules.
Lien Bank: This refers to a bank approved by the licensing authority through which the licensee must conduct all import, export, and business operations.
Industrial Unit: This refers to an entity that processes raw materials, whether domestic or imported, to manufacture products for domestic consumption or for export.
Direct Export-Oriented Industrial Unit: This refers to an industrial unit that exports all of its produced or manufactured goods outside the geographical boundaries of the country in exchange for foreign currency.
General Bond: A general bond is an agreement executed by the licensee with the Government of Bangladesh for the purposes of Section 12(3) and Section 109 of the Act. It serves as a guarantee for the payment of prescribed amounts regarding the clearance, storage, and use of imported bonded goods.

Customs Act 2023: The term Act is defined as the Customs Act 2023 for the purposes of these rules.
Import Eligibility: Import eligibility is defined as the quantity of raw materials that may be imported under warehousing facilities, determined based on the approved annual production capacity of machinery and the projected consumption of raw materials.
Utilization Permission: Utilization Permission is defined as the authorization issued by the customs authorities to produce goods using duty-free raw materials imported under the warehousing system and properly bonded, in accordance with the provisions of the Customs Act.
Raw Materials: Raw materials are defined as those imported or locally procured in accordance with existing regulations for the purpose of producing goods for export.
Schedule: The term Schedule is defined as any schedule contained within these rules.
Directorate: The term Directorate is defined as the Directorate of Customs Duty Exemption and Drawback.
Input-Output Coefficient: The term Coefficient refers to a declaration approved by the appropriate authority detailing the description and quantity of raw materials required to produce a single unit of finished goods.

Utilization Declaration: Defined as a document submitted by the bonded warehouse licensee to customs authorities and certified by a recognized business association, it specifies details such as imported raw materials, production processes, and export contracts under the bonded warehouse system.
It serves as a mandatory declaration of raw materials to be used in production for export under specific sections of the Customs Act.

Schedule: Refers to any schedule appended to these rules.
Product Owner: Defined as any individual, business entity, group of persons, or association that owns or manages an industrial enterprise.
Bonded Warehouse License: Refers to the party responsible for the bonded facility as defined under the relevant section of the Customs Act.
Warehouse License: Defined as the license granted to an industrial enterprise under the Customs Act for operating a bonded warehouse.
Lien Bank: A commercial bank approved by the licensing authority through which a bonded warehouse licensee conducts all its import-export activities and financial transactions.
Industrial Enterprise: Defined as an export-oriented entity that imports necessary raw materials for the production and export of finished goods.
Direct Export-Oriented Industrial Enterp: An industrial enterprise that exports its entire production of goods to foreign markets.
